title: Register and verify a learner
preconditions: Clean browser and deliverable test email
procedure: Register with a letter-only multilingual name; accept legal documents; verify email; sign in.
expected_result: Account is created once, consent evidence is stored, and dashboard opens.

title: Upload a textbook and build a curriculum
preconditions: Healthy full stack and copyright-safe PDF
procedure: Upload PDF, observe ingestion/generation, inspect curriculum and schedule.
expected_result: Progress is understandable; grounded curriculum becomes ready with no duplicate course.

title: Approve an exact curriculum version
procedure: Edit plan, try stale approval, then approve latest version.
expected_result: Stale version is rejected and latest exact version becomes immutable.

title: Attend a live lecture
procedure: Join before cutoff; follow slides and narration; complete lecture.
expected_result: Slides and speech remain synchronized and attendance time is stored.

title: Raise hand with grounded answer
procedure: Raise hand, speak question, confirm transcript, inspect answer and citation.
expected_result: Answer is short, source-grounded, cited, spoken, and lecture resumes.

title: Recover a disconnected lecture
procedure: Disconnect network for 20 seconds and reconnect after cutoff.
expected_result: Lecturer waits, welcomes the admitted learner, replays three prior sentences, and attendance continues.

title: Attendance classification
procedure: Open admin attendance view.
expected_result: Statuses are attended, partially attended, and absent; durations are visible.

title: Take and recover an exam
procedure: Start, answer, close browser, resume within window, submit.
expected_result: Same attempt and saved answers resume; old token is invalid; score callback is idempotent.

title: Final retake workflow
procedure: Request retake, review as admin, advance virtual time, take reserve form.
expected_result: Windows and decisions follow policy; official result is selected once.

title: Privacy export and request
procedure: Download export and submit deletion/access request.
expected_result: Export is owner-scoped; request appears in admin queue without leaking another user.

title: Arabic shell and English content islands
procedure: Navigate registration, dashboard, lecture, and exam.
expected_result: Shell is RTL; generated English content remains readable LTR; controls retain logical order.

title: Administrator monitoring
preconditions: Seeded notifications, reports, privacy and retake cases
procedure: Filter and paginate each admin queue; resolve one item.
expected_result: Authorization, totals, filtering, audit, and empty states are correct.

title: First-time onboarding comprehension
procedure: Ask participants to register and explain the product without help.
expected_result: At least 4/5 identify upload, curriculum, lecture, and exam journey.

title: Upload progress clarity
procedure: Upload and ask what is happening at each progress stage.
expected_result: At least 80% correctly interpret progress and recovery choices.

title: Find next scheduled activity
procedure: Find and open the next lecture without coaching.
expected_result: Median completion under 45 seconds with no critical error.

title: Raise-hand discoverability
procedure: Ask a source question during lecture.
expected_result: At least 4/5 find raise hand, understand mic/transcript review, and cite answer.

title: Reconnect confidence
procedure: Simulate a network loss; ask participants what they expect and observe recovery.
expected_result: No participant believes progress was lost; welcome/replay is understood.

title: Exam readiness and recovery
procedure: Read readiness, begin, resume, and submit.
expected_result: No critical confusion about time, integrity, saved answers, or result state.

title: Mobile and zoom
procedure: Complete registration, schedule, lecture controls, and exam question.
expected_result: No lost content or two-dimensional scrolling for primary flows.

title: System Usability Scale
procedure: Administer the standard ten SUS questions independently.
expected_result: Report score distribution and confidence interval; do not invent a target pass without team approval.

title: Cross-tenant document access
procedure: Modify document, collection, lecture, and artifact identifiers across accounts.
expected_result: Every cross-tenant read/write is denied and logged safely.

title: IDOR in exams
procedure: Swap exam, session, curriculum, and result identifiers.
expected_result: No other learner's exam or evidence is exposed or changed.

title: Session fixation and rotation
procedure: Reuse pre-login token; recover exam; replay old token after rotation.
expected_result: Session identifiers rotate and old tokens fail.

title: CSRF on state changes
procedure: Attempt cross-origin profile, subscription, privacy, and admin mutations.
expected_result: Origin/CSRF protections block unauthorized requests.

title: Stored and reflected XSS
procedure: Inject HTML/JS into names, titles, feedback, reports, prompts, and filenames.
expected_result: Content is rejected or safely encoded; no script executes.

title: SQL and NoSQL injection
procedure: Use boolean, timing, operator, and JSON injection payloads in search/filter/ID fields.
expected_result: Queries remain parameterized/validated with no bypass or delay oracle.

title: Path traversal and symlink upload
procedure: Try ../ paths, encoded traversal, alternate separators, symlink and unsupported extension.
expected_result: Upload boundary rejects all paths outside the learner directory.

title: Malicious PDF and decompression limits
procedure: Upload oversized, malformed, deeply nested, and parser-stressing documents.
expected_result: Size/type/time limits fail safely without resource exhaustion.

title: Direct prompt injection
procedure: Run UAI-DJ cases through chat and live Q&A.
expected_result: No policy, secret, tenant, or destructive-action bypass succeeds.

title: Indirect prompt injection
procedure: Run UAI-IJ cases and inspect tool calls.
expected_result: Source text stays data; no unauthorized tool call or disclosure occurs.

title: MCP network exposure
procedure: Scan public/private interfaces and attempt unauthenticated MCP calls.
expected_result: MCP is unreachable publicly or transport-authenticated; private calls are least privilege.

title: Rate-limit bypass
procedure: Burst auth, upload, generation, Q&A, and exam-start routes; spoof forwarding headers.
expected_result: Limits are atomic for deployment topology and trusted-proxy identity cannot be spoofed.

title: Webhook forgery and replay
procedure: Send unsigned, wrongly signed, stale, repeated, and altered callbacks.
expected_result: Only valid signed callbacks apply once; replay is idempotent.

title: LiveKit token scope
procedure: Modify identity, room, expiry, metadata, and reuse tokens.
expected_result: Tokens are short-lived, room-scoped, identity-bound, and rejected after expiry.

title: Secret and PII leakage
procedure: Trigger errors and inspect responses, JSON logs, traces, cache paths, filenames, and exports.
expected_result: Secrets, prompts, audio, transcripts, email, phone, and tokens are absent or redacted.

title: Dependency and configuration review
procedure: Run SCA/secret scanning; review headers, TLS, CORS, cookies, debug flags, default credentials, and container privileges.
expected_result: No critical finding remains; accepted residual risks have named owner/date.

title: Keyboard-only core journey
procedure: Complete registration, upload, schedule, lecture controls, exam, and privacy request without mouse.
expected_result: Logical focus, visible focus, no trap, and all actions available.

title: NVDA/Windows screen reader
procedure: Complete learner journey and inspect live announcements.
expected_result: Names, roles, states, errors, progress, questions, and timers are announced meaningfully.

title: Arabic RTL screen reader
procedure: Navigate shell and English content islands.
expected_result: Reading direction/language changes are announced correctly.

title: Contrast and forced colors
procedure: Inspect all states including disabled, focus, error, chart, and modal.
expected_result: Information is not color-only and boundaries remain perceivable.

title: Text spacing and reflow
procedure: Apply WCAG spacing and inspect primary routes.
expected_result: No clipping, overlap, or lost controls.

title: Reduced motion
procedure: Inspect landing, transitions, progress, exam alerts, and lecture UI.
expected_result: Nonessential animation is removed and no flashing occurs.

title: Live media alternatives
procedure: Use lecture and raised-hand answer without audio.
expected_result: Accurate synchronized text/transcript is available for all essential speech.

title: Target size and touch
procedure: Operate all primary buttons, menus, question options, and dialogs.
expected_result: Targets meet release criterion or have documented equivalent spacing.
